newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo says chairman Corness to retire.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo says chairman Corness to retire.

text.p: Glaxo Wellcome Plc said on Thursday that its chairman Colin Corness had decided to retire from the post at the end of its annual meeting on May 19, 1997.
Richard Sykes, the current deputy chairman and chief executive, would become chairman from that date, the company said.

Sykes would combine the role of chairman with that of chief executive until the 1998 annual general meeting, after which Sean Lance would become the chief executive. Sykes would then continue as executive chairman.
Roger Hurn, non-executive director, would succeed Sykes as deputy chairman of the drugs and pharmaceuticals giant.
